Every cell separately drawn with clear changes of limbs, head and equipment, never duplicated, mirrored or shifted copies. Generous18percent transparent margins around every cell: whole character AND long tail, shuriken, cape and ALL VFX together at at most65percent cell footprint. Make figures SMALL enough, fully contain every extremity/effect within its own cell, never touch/crop edges or overlap adjacent cells. Consistent character model and weapon in all32 cells. Side/slight three-quarter generally facing RIGHT. Detailed readable16/32bit game pixel clusters, no text/grid/labels/numbers/border/logos/watermark, no opponent, no landscape, floor or cast shadow. No wounds, gore or execution; row5 is a nonlethal presentation of an adapted signature technique. Original fan-art gameplay choreography, NOT official pixel reproduction or source cinematic certification. VINCENT VALENTINE HUMAN FORM, original FFVII1997, same long straight BLACK hair, RED HEADBAND, pale young-adult male face with calm serious expression, ragged long RED shoulder CAPE/high collar, black/dark navy strapped shirt/trousers, golden pointed sabatons and gold armored LEFT forearm/CLAW as reference. CRUCIAL EQUIPMENT HANDEDNESS: anatomical RIGHT NORMAL hand wears a dark glove and holds ONE small black/silver QUICKSILVER PISTOL; anatomical LEFT hand is the GOLD CLAW and stays FREE, never holds the pistol. Side-right or clear three-quarter to make this readable. No extra guns, Cerberus triple-barrel weapon, sword, scythe or Dirge outfit. ALL32 poses are HUMAN, never horns, wings, demon skin, claws replacing BOTH hands, fused gun body or hybrid form. Chaos body will be rendered from a DIFFERENT sheet later. Row1 INTRO: pistol down/right hand; check the small pistol; raise right forearm carefully; calm one-pistol aim with gold LEFT claw relaxed. Row2 OUTRO: lower right-hand pistol; red cape settles; turn partly away; quiet walking step carrying pistol down. Row3 ROUND VICTORY: lower muzzle; controlled breath; set feet; resume right-hand gun guard, left gold claw free. Row4 ROUND DEFEAT: recoil without wound; bring free LEFT claw toward side; bend catching breath; recover low pistol guard. Row5 CHAOS PREPARATION adapted FINALE, STILL HUMAN: lower pistol safely; bend knees and draw free LEFT claw close to chest; small contained crimson/dark AURA around shoulders with cape lifted by energy, body remains fully human; aura fades and straighten into calm human recovery. NO gunshot, attack beam, enemy or literal execution. Row6 VICTORY: right-hand pistol upright near shoulder; lower pistol; settle cape; quiet composed human pose with gold left claw clearly free. Row7 DEFEAT: lean down; bend one knee; kneel with right-hand pistol pointed safely at ground; head bowed taking breath alive. Row8 CHAOS SUPER PREPARATION/RETURN, STILL HUMAN: feet planted and pistol lowered; LEFT gold claw near torso as cape lifts; contained dark-red swirling aura around human shoulders; settle back to calm HUMAN stance. Do NOT draw Chaos wings/face anywhere on this human32-pose sheet. Entire cape, hair, boots and pistol inside each padded cell.
sources.reason: The fourth initial intro pose visibly held the pistol on the golden claw arm. Replace only the intro row with a native correction showing the right normal black-gloved hand on the pistol and the left golden claw free.

sources.prompt: NATIVE PIXEL-ART CORRECTION, horizontal FOUR-CELL ONE-ROW INTRO for VINCENT VALENTINE, original Final Fantasy VII1997, based on supplied4-pose reference. FIX the concrete handedness defect: in the fourth source pose the pistol is incorrectly joined to his GOLD armored LEFT forearm. In ALL FOUR new frames the ONE small Quicksilver PISTOL must be held by the ANATOMICAL RIGHT HUMAN HAND, whose glove is plain BLACK and forearm has dark cloth/bare pale skin, with absolutely NO GOLD ARMOR on the gun-holding wrist. The anatomical LEFT forearm/hand has Vincent's GOLD CLAW and stays FREE, visibly hanging on the other side, never holding or supporting the pistol. Show a clear slightly FRONT THREE-QUARTER stance facing RIGHT so we can plainly see BOTH different hands in every frame. Four successive intro poses:1 right-hand pistol safely down and left gold claw relaxed at other side;2 check the pistol held only in normal black-gloved RIGHT hand while left gold claw remains visibly free;3 raise the right black-gloved pistol hand near shoulder while left gold claw hangs free;4 right BLACK-GLOVED NORMAL HUMAN hand aims the small pistol to RIGHT, elbow bent/arm forward, left GOLD claw held distinctly DOWN beside/behind left hip, NO gold wrist or fingers touching the gun. Same long black hair, red headband, pale human face, ragged RED shoulder cape/high collar, black strapped clothes, gold pointed boots as reference. HUMAN in all4, no demon anatomy/wings/horns, no extra weapon. EXACT4COLUMNS×1ROW, four distinct full-body poses on TRUE TRANSPARENT background, wide18percent transparent margins EACH CELL, entire cape/boots/hand/pistol safely contained; about1536x384 or1024x256. Figures detailedpixelart, same model/scale, every limb and both hands readable. No giant gun, no floor/shadow/opponent/text/grid/logo/watermark, no duplicate/offset copies. Re-draw correct hands and poses NATIVELY, never merely mirror the bad gun arm. This is an original corrective adaptation, not an official-source-pixel claim.
